_meta.units: mm (inches also given where the source is in inches)
_meta.method: Read issue #30 and PR #78 (all comments) and glovebox-options.md on PR #78's head branch (copilot/look-up-glovebox-options). LabX returned an empty HTTP 202 (bot challenge) to the runner, so the listing HTML was fetched read-only through the CubXL Pi (one curl to stdout, --limit-rate 400k, ~225 kB); its 44 photos came straight from cdn.labx.com on the runner (~41 MB, no Pi traffic). The data plate, fascia badge, QA sticker and AtmosPure label were read from those photos. Labconco documents were downloaded from labconco.com's CDN (ctfassets): the current Protector CA manual 5426400 Rev G (2023, Appendix B dimension drawing, rendered at 300-400 dpi and read), the product page, and the Precise CA spec sheet (to rule the 'Precise' label out). The 2001-era manual 50755 Rev E (2002) came from expotechusa.com (PDF) and manualsdir.com. Cole-Parmer's legacy 5060000/5070000 pages are Cloudflare-challenged from both the runner and the Pi and were not read. MSE product data came from the Shopify product .json on the runner. 'estimated_keys' are photo-scaled or inferred; everything else has a source quote. The inches values from Labconco drawings are exact, and mm = in x 25.4 rounded to 0.1 mm.
not_done: No tape-measure check of the actual unit: the seller's 38 in height and 40 in depth disagree with the current-model drawing (45.7 in, 34.4 in), and no 2001-era dimension drawing was found.
The data plate suffix -9147 was not confirmed with Labconco.

choice.why: The lab's latest explicit cheap pick is still the used Labconco controlled-atmosphere glove box with stand, $2,999, private seller in Birmingham, Alabama (PR #78, item #8). Gage Erickson proposed it on 2026-07-20 (https://github.com/vertical-cloud-lab/byu-vcl/pull/78#issuecomment-5025726050: "I'm thinking the $3000 upgradeable option might be our best bet for now.") and Sterling Baird agreed the same day (https://github.com/vertical-cloud-lab/byu-vcl/pull/78#issuecomment-5028159005: "The alabama listing looks nice, and I think with shipping it could be sub-$5k."). Nothing has been bought or quoted since. On 2026-09-17 the interim spec said the box 'likely will be made of plexi glass' (https://github.com/vertical-cloud-lab/byu-vcl/issues/30#issuecomment-5717179521). On 2026-09-23 Gage asked about the MSE acrylic box, and Claude's 2026-09-25 eBay survey suggested a Plas-Labs 830-ABB, a Cleatech or a Terra (https://github.com/vertical-cloud-lab/byu-vcl/issues/30#issuecomment-5828568081). No lab member has picked any of those. So the Labconco is modelled as the primary and the MSE PRO acrylic box with airlock as the alternative.
caveats: The LabX record's own availability window is product_available_from 2024-04-13 to product_available_to 2024-07-12, although is_active=1. The listing may be stale, so confirm it is still for sale.

The earlier comments treated this unit as 'purge-level as sold, AtmosPure-upgradable' and 'fiberglass liner (not groundable)'. The photos and data plate show otherwise: it is a stainless-lined Protector (catalog 50701) that already has a 2001-vintage AtmosPure 51218-00 recirculating purifier. The purifier's condition and regeneration state are unknown, and no O2/H2O monitors are visible.

labconco_ca.name: Labconco Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, single width, Type 304 stainless steel liner, automatic Pressure Control Module, 115 V; fitted with an AtmosPure 51218-00 gas purifier; on a Labconco mobile base stand with casters
labconco_ca.catalog_decoded: In Labconco's 2002 scheme (manual 50755 Rev E), 50600/50700/50800 = basic / + automatic pressure control module / + purge-fill module. The 5th digit is 0 for a fiberglass liner and 1 for stainless. The -00/-02 suffix is 115 V / 230 V. So 50701-00 = stainless liner, automatic pressure control, 115 V. The trailing 9147 is not in the manual. It is probably a factory special, which would fit the purifier being factory-integrated rather than the stock accessory cabinet (unconfirmed). The current catalog scheme (5426400 Rev G) uses 50600/50601 manual and 50800/50801 auto instead.
labconco_ca.series: Protector (fascia badge reads 'LABCONCO PROTECTOR GLOVE BOX'). It is NOT a Precise box, despite the listing text. The Precise CA box has a one-piece polyethylene shell, measures 52.7 x 31.6 x 40.0 in, and has a cylindrical 11.0 in ID x 12.0 in transfer chamber.
labconco_ca.electrical: 115 V, 1 phase, 60 Hz, 20 A (data plate). The 2002 manual asks for a 115 V 60 Hz 20 A receptacle.

listing.seller: Registered LabX User (private; member since April 7th, 2024; 1 active listing), Birmingham, AL 35205
seller_statements: Used very little, maintained at a nearby university; 'It all works as it should.'
Comes with a LABCONCO rolling stand.
A Welch DuoSeal vacuum pump is listed separately. A rotary-vane pump sits on the stand's lower shelf in the photos, so ask whether it is included.
Seller has a forklift to load a truck or trailer; the buyer arranges shipping.
Size fields in the listing record: width 63, length 40, height 38 in; weight 500 lbs (seller's guess, with the stand).

labconco_ca.side_profile_for_cad_in: Box bottom at 0; front sloped plane 10 deg from vertical, leaning away from the operator. Interior: floor depth 28.0, ceiling depth 22.4, height 32.0 front / 28.1 rear. stand.model: Labconco 5062000 Glove Box Mobile Stand (2002 accessory list; the 'LABCONCO STANDS/CARTS' label on this unit has its model field obscured in the photos)
stand.construction: Welded epoxy-coated steel, black phenolic laminate top, two pedestal uprights with height-adjust holes on T-foot bases, lower storage shelf, 5 in (127 mm) swivel casters with locking brakes
stand.current_equivalent: 5235500 (casters): 60 x 31 in top, 33-40 in (838-1016 mm) adjustable
stand.box_overhang: The box is 63.5 in wide on a 60 in stand, so the transfer-chamber side overhangs ~3.5 in (photos show the right end overhanging)
stand.overall_H_on_stand_note: Seller's 38 in plus the 30-37 in stand range. It would be 75.7-82.7 in with the current-model 45.7 in height.

window.shape: Sloped front: one flat pane leaning back 10 deg from vertical. The glove ports are mounted in the glass. Below it is a vertical lamp facade (short on the 2001 unit).
window.view_H_note: 27.7 in on the drawing; the product page says 27.6 in.
window.slope_check: The drawing's interior depth runs 28.0 in at the floor and 22.4 in at the ceiling over 32.0 in height: atan(5.6/32.0) = 9.9 deg.
window.glass: 3/8 in (9.5 mm) laminated safety glass (optional 3/8 in polycarbonate), removable window frame of 12 ga epoxy-coated steel held by 30 screws

glove_ports.material: Epoxy-coated aluminium, double-grooved (dual O-ring grooves). Neoprene gloves 0.015 in thick, 30 in long, size 9-3/4.

antechamber.type: Rectangular vacuum transfer chamber, evacuate and refill (gauge 0 to -29.5 inHg)
antechamber.side: Right end, as seen from the front. Its axis runs left-right, the inner door opens onto the main chamber's right wall, and the outer door is on the right end face.
antechamber.position_est: Spans roughly 9-22 in back from the base front (side-view scaling)
antechamber.doors: Inner and outer doors are counterbalanced, pivot upward and have quick latches. On stainless models both are Type 304 stainless steel (inner 11 ga, outer 12 ga); fiberglass models use 3/4 in clear acrylic. The photos show stainless doors and a brushed-stainless chamber.
antechamber.loading_clearance: Labconco: 'Adequate space to the right of the transfer chamber is required for loading and unloading.'

purifier.model: Labconco AtmosPure 51218-00, 115 V 50/60 Hz, CB-1 10 A (label read from a listing photo). This is the original generation; the current AtmosPure Re-Gen is 5121810.
purifier.layout_from_photos: An 'AtmosPure Control' box sits on top of the right-hand control column. The heated purifier column is in a hinged black enclosure at the rear left corner (as seen from the front); its panel has isolation valves A/B (normal/regeneration) and a hydrogen purge flowmeter. The oil pressure-relief bubbler is mounted mid-rear.

rear_purifier_enclosure_est_mm.note: Estimated from the rear photo (scaled to the 41.5 in body); D is the seller's 40 in minus 34.4 in

purifier.performance_if_working: Labconco quotes 0.2 ppm O2 / 1 ppm H2O for current stainless boxes with an AtmosPure Re-Gen. Regeneration needs a hydrogen/inert gas mix. The purifier's condition is unknown.

labconco_ca.control_column_2001: Right-end cabinet. From the top, the front face has: AtmosPure Control; a blank LABCONCO panel; the Pressure Control Module (auto, with foot pedal); the Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box gauges (box pressure +/-5 in w.g., transfer chamber vacuum) with light/outlet switches; and the Glove box / Transfer chamber valve panel. The current model instead has a 22.4 in-tall transfer-chamber housing with a small controller.
labconco_ca.interior_services: One right and one left interior 115 V receptacle, 6 A combined, switched from outside (2002 manual). Pass-through and drying-train fittings at the rear.
labconco_ca.material: Liner: Type 304 stainless steel, 12 gauge (~2.7 mm), 3/4 in (19 mm) inside corner radii; groundable. Exterior: black epoxy-coated steel panels. Window: 3/8 in laminated safety glass. Transfer-chamber doors: 304 stainless.
labconco_ca.mass_note: Labconco lists 500 lb (225 kg) for a stainless Protector, box only. The seller's 'approx 500 lbs with the stand' is a guess. With the AtmosPure and stand, ~250-300 kg is plausible (estimate). The 2002 manual requires a stand rated for 500 lb minimum.

cad_recommendation_in.body: 41.5 W x 30.0 base D x 38 H block. Front face is a 36.0 x 27.7 window plane tilted 10 deg back, starting 3.6 in up. A vertical facade block (~6 in) sits above the window.
cad_recommendation_in.ports: Two 8.0 in ID rings (11 in OD) in the window, centres 12.3 and 29.3 in from the left edge, 9.3 in above the box bottom
cad_recommendation_in.right_cabinet: 16.3 W x ~30 D (est.) x ~31 H (est.) on the right end, with the AtmosPure control box (~4 in, est.) on top. Transfer chamber 11 x 13 x 20 in inside, outer door on the right face; door hardware brings the total width to 63.5 in (66.3 in when open)
cad_recommendation_in.rear: Oil bubbler mid-rear and purifier enclosure rear-left, taking total depth to ~40 in
cad_recommendation_in.stand: 60 x 30 in top at 30-37 in height (choose 34 in), lower shelf, 4 casters

labconco_ca.notes: Use the 2023 Labconco drawing for the liner, window, ports and transfer chamber; the 2002 manual describes the same 8 in ID / 17 in ports, 3/8 in glass at 10 deg and pivoting transfer-chamber doors. Use the seller's 38 in for this unit's height (without stand), not the current model's 45.7 in. The 2001 body has a much shorter lamp facade, and scaling photo 00 by the 27.7 in window gives ~37-38 in. The 2001 right-hand section is a taller control column than the current 22.4 in housing. The 40 in depth probably includes the rear bubbler and purifier; the box body itself is 34.4 in. Measure before relying on either. Door/elevator check: 63.5 in wide x 34.4 in deep body; take it off the stand for doorways. The glove box sits on the stand with its transfer-chamber (right) end overhanging a 60 in stand. The doser (HR-100A balance) must pass an 11 x 13 in opening and a 20 in-long chamber, or go in through the removable window frame.
